summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the exact requested RSA public key and key-only SSH authentication. The Ubuntu 16.04.7 release, 4.4.0-210 kernel, and OpenSSH 7.2 package remain unchanged. Configuration persisted through a verified node reboot.

Restarted node1 once and verified its new boot identity and complete SSH recovery.
